<?php
/* A slug helper that carries the same alphabet the droppers do, and explodes it, and never XORs anything. */
function to_base36(int $n): string {
    $digits = explode(',', implode(',', str_split('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789')));
    $out = '';
    do { $out = $digits[$n % 36] . $out; $n = intdiv($n, 36); } while ($n > 0);
    return $out;
}
